scope: deterministic macOS local-process crash recovery comparison; not high availability, recovery latency, or external-effect exactly-once

comparison.model: frozen local adapter for EvoForge; none for Hermes
comparison.fault: SIGKILL one local process after the authoritative work unit is durable
comparableOutcomes: the authoritative work unit is not lost after reopening canonical storage
one crash causes exactly one bounded recovery action
recovery does not create duplicate terminal records
nonComparableOutcomes: EvoForge resumes a native DSH Goal round while Hermes reclaims a Kanban worker run
wall-clock recovery latency and service-manager restart are excluded
no external side effect is executed, so exactly-once delivery is excluded
comparison.primaryMetric: lost authoritative work units after one local SIGKILL; lower is better
